'''Gilbert''' (Japanese: '''ゲンキ''' ''Genki'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG126|Saved by the Beldum]]''. He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] who competed in the preliminary rounds of the [[Ever Grande Conference]]. 

Gilbert went up against {{Ash}} during the preliminary rounds. Using his {{p|Hitmonlee}}, he was determined to defeat [[Ash's Pikachu]]. However, {{p|Pikachu}}'s speed caused his Pokémon's {{m|High Jump Kick}}s to miss and [[crash damage|injure his leg]]. He was able to gain a slight advantage when Hitmonlee used {{m|Mega Kick}} on Pikachu, but the {{type|Fighting}} Pokémon ended up losing the {{pkmn|battle}}. With that loss, Gilbert was out of the tournament.
